snapshot.text: Public system centred on Vaiola Hospital, with one of the world's highest rates of non-communicable disease. Typhoid and dengue outbreaks occurred in 2026, and a World Bank grant supports NCD control.

priorities.title: Dengue outbreak
priorities.text: Tonga reported a dengue outbreak in April 2026.

priorities.title: NCD control
priorities.text: A World Bank grant to tackle non-communicable diseases and strengthen services.
